race.title: Book Hospitality At Huntingdon Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: The tentative nod goes to JAMADA , who made a reasonably encouraging start over fences when fourth at Worcester recently and Olly Murphy's 6-y-o is open to improvement, especially if brushing up his jumping. Inside Man showed much more what he's about when runner-up at Chepstow earlier in the month, so he looks a big threat, with Sweeper System rounding off the shortlist. JAMADA (IRE) INSIDE MAN (FR) SWEEPER SYSTEM (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Inside Man (15/8), Sweeper System (7/2), Jamada (4/1), Black Hawk Eagle (7/1), Yes Indeed (8/1), Homme D'Un Soir (12/1), Granny Hawkins (14/1)
